# Skills Consolidation Changelog

Authoritative record of the skills-ecosystem consolidation. Mirror rows for the three retired directories also live in `${HOME|backslash}\.codex\skills\_retired\README.md`.

Legend — **Operation**: GIT-INIT / MERGE / RETIRE / SHARPEN / INSTALL / DELETE / REFRESH.
Real skill directories live in `${HOME|backslash}\.codex\skills\`; `${HOME|backslash}\.claude\skills\` holds junctions into them (except real dirs `neon-postgres`, `ui-ux-pro-max`).

## 2026-07-02 — VisualForge plugin refresh (plugins boundary follow-up)

Scoped out of the skills consolidation above; done the same day. Key discovery: the "installed" plugin dir `${HOME|backslash}\.claude\plugins\marketplaces\local-desktop-app-uploads\visualforge` is a **symlink to `${DEPENDENCY:visualforge|backslash}`** — plugin *content* was never stale; only the version metadata was, and the plugin was silently **failing to load** every session (`claude plugin list` → `✘ failed to load: … plugin.json … homepage: Invalid URL`).

| Operation | Source → Target | Why | How to restore |
|---|---|---|---|
| REFRESH | `VisualForge\.claude-plugin\plugin.json` + `marketplace.json` (this repo) | Root-cause load-failure fix: `"homepage": ""` / `"repository": ""` fail the CLI's URL validation, so the whole plugin (all 31 skills) was skipped at session start — removed both empty fields; added the missing marketplace `description` (validate warning). Both manifests now pass `claude plugin validate`. | `git -C "${DEPENDENCY:skills-root|backslash}" revert <this commit>` (re-adds the empty fields; the plugin will fail to load again). |
| REFRESH | `${DEPENDENCY:visualforge|backslash}` v1.8.0 → `visualforge@local-desktop-app-uploads` (user scope) | Installed metadata was stale at 1.0.0 (2026-05-18): bumped the plugin row in `…\plugins\marketplaces\local-desktop-app-uploads\.claude-plugin\marketplace.json` to 1.8.0 (+ description/category/keywords parity), then `claude plugin update visualforge@local-desktop-app-uploads` → CLI installed to the versioned cache `…\plugins\cache\local-desktop-app-uploads\visualforge\1.8.0` (188 files, fixed manifest verified) and set `installed_plugins.json` to 1.8.0. Verified: `claude plugin list` → 1.8.0 ✔ enabled; `claude plugin details` → all 31 skills resolve (~2.8k tok always-on). | Set the marketplace row back to the old version and re-run `claude plugin update`; or `claude plugin uninstall visualforge@local-desktop-app-uploads`. |
| DELETE | `VisualForge\.orphaned_at` (never committed) | The CLI update wrote an orphan marker into the OLD install path — **through the symlink into this repo**. Deleted; `.orphaned_at` added to `.gitignore` so future plugin ops can't pollute the repo. NOTE the standing hazard: any Claude Code op that writes/deletes in the marketplace's `visualforge` dir lands in this repo via the symlink; the git history is the safety net. | Nothing to restore — machinery file. |

**Maintenance note (next release):** the marketplace symlink keeps repo → marketplace live, but installs now come from the versioned cache. To ship a new VisualForge version: bump `version` in BOTH `VisualForge\.claude-plugin\plugin.json` and `VisualForge\.claude-plugin\marketplace.json`, mirror the row version in `…\plugins\marketplaces\local-desktop-app-uploads\.claude-plugin\marketplace.json`, then `claude plugin update visualforge@local-desktop-app-uploads` and restart the session.
